newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 18.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Tuesday.
WASHINGTON - A new study shows blacks and Hispanics face discrimination more than two out of five times when they try to rent an apartment in the Washington area.
WASHINGTON - Last weekend's World Trade Organisation agreement on basic telecommunications among more than 70 nations signals a new era of lower-cost international calls and investment.
SAN FRANCISCO - Apple Computer Inc's latest PowerBook is the fastest laptop on the market, but some analysts wonder whether the company can reclaim its throne as the laptop king.

LOS ANGELES - Leaders of the AFL-CIO opened their annual mid-winter meetings far away from the plush resorts of Florida and Puerto Rico in an effort to create a new symbolism for a changing labour movement.
